answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by making identity a costly, verifiable record rather than a renewable label. Newcomers stake collateral, perform unpredictable work, and collect signatures from reviewers outside their cluster. A beacon of attested history must confirm every claim, a nectar reward stream is throttled per identity, and a velvet ledger logs graded results so duplicated behavior stands out. Audits slash faked bonds, so swarms add overhead without adding credibility.
